_about: The sensor's life from a Nightscout source (docs/44 'Person × Source': Nightscout's sensor life = its Sensor
Start): the newest treatment whose eventType is 'Sensor Start' or 'Sensor Change' (isValid not false, its
created_at (else date / mills) not after 'now'; at the same time the Sensor Start's) starts the sensor; its 'id'
is that document's identifier, else _id (a new sensor = a new id: its reminders start again). The site doesn't
say how long the sensor lasts, so contracts/sensor/life.json's defaults apply (a sensor that doesn't say:
defaultWarmupMin warm-up, defaultWearMin wear), and its warm-up rule: warming from the start until a reading
newer than it ('latest'), at most warmupGraceS past the warm-up's end; 'ended' from 'end' on (readings that still
come alert as usual; no data stays quiet). 'expect' null = no sensor event: life unknown (no reminders, no
countdown). Your glucose only drives the sensor reminders (sources.json keying 'owner'); someone else's shows
on the card. Generated by generate.py from these cases and life.json.

cases.name: a Sensor Start 2 days ago, readings since: active, ends after the default wear
the newest of Sensor Start and Sensor Change wins
both at the same time (Sukrara writes both for one sensor): the Sensor Start names it
started 30 min ago, no reading since: warming up
a reading since the start ends the warm-up
past the default wear: ended (no data stays quiet)
a deleted one (isValid false) doesn't count
one logged ahead of now doesn't count yet
no sensor event on the site: the sensor's life is unknown
